Theorem
[four-dimensional positive-curvature-operator sphere theorem] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 5.2.2\group Differentiable Sphere Theorems

A compact four-manifold with positive curvature operator is diffeomorphic to the four-sphere $\mathbb {S}^4$ or the real projective space $\mathbb {RP}^4$.
